notes:
Overview: Cortex Contact Solutions is a mid-to-large enterprise provider of omnichannel contact center software used by telecom and retail CX teams. They want real-time agent assist with streaming suggestion UI, automated tool-calls (CRM update, ticket tagging), and reliable performance under predictable daily peaks and large promotional spikes.

Key goals / success metrics: 
- Reduce average handle time (AHT) by 18-25% for tier-1 agents.
- Suggestion latency target: 50-120ms (end-to-end) for streaming completions.
- Support 300 simultaneous active agent sessions / region with graceful degradation to cached suggestions.
- Ticket summarization accuracy >85% (ROUGE/QA pass) and safe fallback to human summary when confidence low.

Deployment/preferences: 
- Prefer Dedicated pools in NA + EU for low latency; private control plane for regulated accounts.
- VPC peering and on-prem connector required for CRM tool-calls to internal systems.
- KMS integration mandatory for PII fields; retention controls to satisfy telecom regulator.

Security/compliance path: 
- Completed initial security questionnaire (see drive link).
- Need SOC2 evidence and ISO27001 attestation; legal wants data residency clause for EU customers.
- Pen-test scheduled but delayed: blocker SUP-8421.
